tool_args.rationale: The coupled ODE, square-root siphon variants, and Hill-2 inhibition all missed the confirmation tolerance. The archive provides a distinct barrier-activated flux with sink inhibition and an open-sign square-root contribution; the eight observations cover varied input and sink levels, permitting numerical fitting without another probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It was already acquired, and the current eight rows span broad input and sink-gradient ranges; another batch is not the most relevant next step.

considered_alternatives.option: Revisit the coupled memory ODE or two-layer square-root siphon
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation refuted the ODE and both siphon variants, so their stationary forms are not supported by the measured outcomes.

considered_alternatives.option: Competitive Hill-2 inhibition with linear bleed
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: This four-parameter stationary candidate was also refuted on fresh confirmation despite adequate sink-gradient span.
There is no reported high-frequency sign oscillation, and fresh confirmation has not yet refuted all plausible stationary mechanisms; the distinct barrier-modulated siphon remains testable.
